title: KCP diagnose request (DESIGN.md §11.6.1; derived — gap note KG3)
description: Read: never mutates authoritative or user-visible state and never carries meta (closed shape — a read carrying meta, hence an idempotency key, fails; §11.2, R0 KENV-01). Installation diagnostics (§11.6.1 diagnose/audit_export family; audit_export and its step-up bind installation_admin_v1, K3). Classified as a read: it changes no authoritative domain or user-visible state, and §11.2 lets reads append security/audit access records (gap note KG3). Registry (core_v1): surface operator / principal (assurance: current login). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

checks.description: Narrowing-only selection of registered diagnostics; absent or empty selects all (derived — gap note KG3). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

args.description: Derived args (gap note KG3): DESIGN.md spells no diagnose payload. Realm scoping travels in the envelope realm_id; realm and role dependencies bind only where the diagnostic is realm-scoped (registry constraint).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
